expectedStdoutMatchSemantics: substring of the recorded stdout; 'fail 0' is present in both the spec ('ℹ fail 0') and TAP ('# fail 0') reporter summaries; no exact pass-count fragment is pinned so added test depth still satisfies the plan

requiredPassingTests.name: CLI process satisfies its output contract
a user receives the exact promised greeting

cliCheck.assertedReturnValueRelation: expectedStdout equals assertedReturnValue followed by exactly one '\n'

acceptance.rule: command exited 0 AND observedTestPassCount >= expectedTestPassCount AND planSatisfied
acceptance.observedTestPassCount: integer N from the recorded runner summary line 'pass N' (spec 'ℹ pass N' or TAP '# pass N')
planSatisfied: every requiredPassingTests name is reported as passing ('✔ <name>' or 'ok N - <name>')
cliCheck recorded exitStatus is 0 and stdout equals expectedStdout exactly
cliCheck recorded stdout without its single trailing '\n' equals assertedReturnValue
evidence binds the current digests of generated/hello-world.mjs and both test files; test digests equal the basis below

evidence.carrier: admitted command-execution (C2) observations from an actual run of both fixed commands on the current subject
mustRecord: resulting test observations (tests, pass, fail, test names)
notEvidence: an author's report or local run
evidence.planRole: declares expectations that must agree with the fixed commands; it is not the runtime source of the commands

baseline.observed: command 0 exit 0 stdout 'Hello world!\n'; command 1 exit 1, pass 0, fail 2
baseline.status: historical counterevidence about these exact bytes; not retargeted and not discarded

postCorrection.observed: command 0 exit 0 stdout 'Hello, world!\n'; command 1 exit 0, pass 2, fail 0

lineage.currentnessRule: only evidence bound to the current generated/hello-world.mjs digest supports current behavior; a later CLI change makes behavior evidence historical but does not invalidate this plan's expectations
